tema: Advanced Passive — It is said that... / He is believed to...

vocabulario.traduccion: el más antiguo de la ciudad

cast_dialogue.linea: Formal English loves distance, heroes. 'It is said that...', 'He is believed to...' — the passive of reputation and report.
The old studio is said to be the oldest in the city. Its owner is believed to have photographed three generations.
It is reported that over ten thousand portraits were taken there. Incredible!
The archive was thought to be lost, but it was found intact in a metal box.
The collection is expected to travel to the national museum. My portrait is in it, mis héroes — from 1965!

inicio.definicion_pragmatica: Impersonal reporting: 'It is said/reported/thought that + clause' OR 'subject + is said/believed/expected + to-infinitive'. For earlier actions use the perfect infinitive: 'He is believed to have photographed...'. Common in news and formal writing.

filas: It is said that the studio is haunted.
She is thought to have left.
say, believe, report, think, expect, know, rumour
It is known to be true.

'He is believed to has left' is correct.

guion: Sofía: Have you read the article about Ben's studio discovery?
Kenji: Yes! It says the studio is said to be the oldest in the city.
Sofía: And the owner is believed to have photographed three generations of the same families.
Kenji: Incredible. It is reported that over ten thousand portraits were taken there.
Sofía: The archive was thought to be lost after the flood, you know.
Kenji: But it was found intact in a metal box!
Sofía: And now the collection is expected to travel to the national museum.

reading.texto: The old studio is said to be the oldest in the city. Its owner is believed to have photographed three generations of local families. It is reported that over ten thousand portraits were taken there between 1950 and 2010. The archive was thought to be lost, but it was found intact in a metal box. The negatives are now being restored, and the collection is expected to travel to the national museum next year.

preguntas.afirmacion: The studio is said to be the oldest in the city.
The archive was destroyed by the flood.
The collection will stay in the city.
